description: Adds a placeholder setting to an item.

database.description: The context database. Sent when addressing the item or the placeholder setting by ID -- a path carries its own database prefix (e.g. master:/sitecore/content/Home).

finalLayout.description: Specifies layout to add the rendering placeholder setting to. If 'true', the final layout is used, otherwise - shared layout.

id.description: The ID of the item to add the placeholder setting to. Supply this or path.

key.description: The key of the placeholder setting to add.

language.description: The language version of the item to add the placeholder setting to.

path.description: The path of the item to add the placeholder setting to. Supply this or id.

placeholderSettingId.description: The ID of the placeholder setting to add. Supply this or placeholderSettingPath.

placeholderSettingPath.description: The path of the placeholder setting to add. Supply this or placeholderSettingId.

name: presentation-add-placeholder-setting
